title: Fix Orthographic Grid Scroll Lod
description: 3d: The grid adjustment to scrolling works fine in perspective windows but e.g. in top view it doesnt work. Make sure all projects have this. MCP unavailable; ticket on disk. Goal: 🎯r2602/🎯runningsketchpad. Root cause: automatic LOD/grid step uses camera distance, but orthographic zoom changes zoom without dollying.
summary: Fixed orthographic (e.g. Top) LOD grid not retuning on scroll. Automatic LOD previously used only camera eye→target distance; ortho scroll changes zoom without dollying, so the grid froze. Shared infinite-world R3F bridge now maps ortho zoom to an equivalent perspective distance via the inverse of worldProjectionMatchedOrthoZoom (50° reference FOV), so puzzle3d/cad/aggregator and every WorldLodBridge consumer inherit the fix. Vitest 192 pass; verify-ortho-lod.mjs confirms zoom-out coarsens the grid. Also repaired world-r3f vitest include/alias after emoji path layout. MCP unavailable for ticket_open/close — ticket kept on disk.
